@id.description: The file ID, urn:uuid:<file_id>. Keep it when moving or re-registering the file. Changed content gets a new ID. IDs must be unique within the sidecar.

@type.description: The JSON-LD type. cr:FileObject or cr:FileSet for distribution items.

additionalType.description: The RDDC class of a distribution item, as a CURIE such as rddc:FhirNdjsonFile. Selects the required fields.

assay.description: The assay that produced the data.

compression.description: Compression applied to the file's bytes, if any.

contentSize.description: Size of the file in bytes.

contentUrl.description: Object key relative to the batch prefix; Croissant resolves it against the sidecar's location.

encodingFormat.description: Media type of the content (after decompression when compression is set).

identifier.description: IDs assigned to the file by other systems.

md5.description: Optional; lets the platform compare with Synapse file handles and single-part S3 ETags.

modality.description: The kind of data in the file.

name.description: File name, by convention the contentUrl.

platform.description: The instrument or sequencing platform that produced the data.

processingHints.description: Informational key-value pairs for downstream pipelines.

recordCount.description: Rows, resources or documents in the file, when counted.

sensitivity.description: Sensitivity information for the batch or file. File-level contains* flags override the batch values.

sha256.description: SHA-256 checksum of the file, as lowercase hexadecimal.

subjectIds.description: Subject IDs the file contains. Each must appear in the subject table.

valueOrigins.description: How tools filled in values on this node.

wasDerivedFrom.description: References to input files in this sidecar, such as the alignment used to call variants.

description: Source register values issued by the ACT at registration. The generator and local validator read this plain JSON file, rddc_source.json. It is separate from the sidecar.

deliveryRole.description: The delivery role ID, such as an IAM role ARN. Included for information; the platform enforces the role.

issuedBy.description: The agent that issued the descriptor.

modalities.description: Modalities the source is registered to deposit.

prefixPattern.description: Template for batch prefixes, with {sourceId} and {batchId} placeholders, ending with a slash. Example: "{sourceId}/{batchId}/".

registerVersion.description: The source register version used to issue the descriptor or draft the sidecar.

sourceId.description: The source register ID. Must match the delivery role used for upload.
